constraints_observed: No virus-host association labels were used at any point.
No prediction model was trained; no similarity was computed.
Family-level ViralZone text is labelled FAMILY_ONLY and was never promoted to species annotations.
Strain/isolate annotations are kept as VERIFIED_DESCENDANT with their original taxid and accession; never relabelled as species-level evidence.
Missing annotation is recorded as missing, never as a biological negative.

ViralZone sections matching host/receptor/tropism/transmission/vector/reservoir/pathology/epidemiology patterns were withheld (text blanked, row retained with EXCLUDED_HOST_LEAKAGE_RISK) to prevent label leakage.
